name: Fanatics Studios × LA28 Original Art Storytelling Collaboration

company.name: Fanatics Studios / OBB Media
company.description: Potential premium original-art storytelling collaboration tied to Fanatics Studios' LA28 work, combining elite athlete access, filmed creation, reveals, content, physical legacy pieces, exhibition, gifting and charitable components leading into the 2028 Olympic Games.

nextMove: Await Michael Ratner's response. If he replies, prioritize learning who directly owns the LA28 work and shape the concept around Fanatics Studios' actual content, athlete and production strategy. If no response, send one concise follow-up after approximately 7-10 business days. If still no engagement, route through a relevant Fanatics Studios/OBB executive or communications contact rather than repeatedly chasing Michael.
strategicValue: Potential career-changing global visibility through Olympic storytelling, major athlete access, premium media exposure, institutional and collector credibility, future Fanatics/Topps expansion, high-value brand relationships and a platform that could reposition Keegan from elite sports artist to a cultural storyteller documenting defining moments in sport.
notes: Keegan Hall sent the initial outreach directly to Michael Ratner on September 15, 2026 at michael.ratner@obbmedia.com.

Opportunity trigger: Fanatics Studios is building major storytelling and content initiatives around LA28, creating a long-lead window for a premium original-art property integrated into athlete narratives and the broader road to the Games.

Keegan deliberately chose a peer-to-peer executive communication style rather than a formal artist introduction. Future outreach from Keegan should generally preserve this concise, confident, conversational tone and avoid low-friction asks that immediately require meetings or scheduled calls.
Initial email established Fanatics credibility through Keegan's work with Fanatics/Topps, most notably the 2025 Topps Update Series where 40 original Keegan Hall art cards were inserted into packs.

Email also highlighted that Michael Jordan owns one of Keegan's originals, that Keegan created artwork for Rory McIlroy and Augusta National after Rory's Masters win with Augusta National now owning the original, and that Keegan's artwork has helped raise more than $850,000 for charity.

Core concept: use original artwork as part of the storytelling leading into LA28, potentially following a select group of athletes through the creation process and building toward filmed reveals, content, physical legacy pieces, exhibition, gifting and other moments around the Games.

Preferred first-response objective is simply to validate interest and/or get routed to the person closest to the LA28 work, not to force a meeting request. The closing question used was: 'Do you think this would be worth exploring further? If someone else on your team is closer to the LA28 work, happy to connect with them instead.'

This should be treated as a top-tier strategic opportunity with long lead time and potentially order-of-magnitude upside in prestige, collector access, media exposure, brand relationships and future licensing or content opportunities.

Do not overbuild a full proposal before internal interest is established. If Michael or his team engages, then build a tailored concept around their actual LA28 priorities, athletes, production slate, rights constraints and commercial objectives.

If routed internally, likely stakeholders may include strategy/growth, creative development/production, branded content, athlete storytelling, LA28 partnership leadership or executive production teams.

latestCommunication.subject: Fanatics Studios x LA28
latestCommunication.summary: Keegan contacted Michael Ratner directly regarding a potential Fanatics Studios × LA28 collaboration. He referenced his prior Fanatics/Topps work, including 40 original art cards in the 2025 Topps Update Series, and proposed integrating original artwork into athlete storytelling leading into the Games through filmed creation, reveals, content, physical legacy pieces, exhibition, gifting and related moments. Keegan highlighted Michael Jordan ownership, the Rory McIlroy/Augusta National original and more than $850,000 raised through his artwork, then asked whether the idea would be worth exploring further or should be routed to someone closer to the LA28 work.
